question_records.stem: Calculate the amount of substance in moles for 7.22 x 10^23 formula units of zinc phosphate, Zn3(PO4)2(s).
Calculate the mass of 0.415 mol of aluminum sulfate, Al2(SO4)3(s).
How many hydrogen atoms are present in 0.750 mol of ammonia, NH3(g)?
A compound is 52.2% carbon, 13.1% hydrogen, and 34.7% oxygen by mass. Its molar mass is 92.1 g/mol. Determine the molecular formula of the compound.
question_records.answer_hint: Empirical formula C2H6O; molecular formula C4H12O2

question_records.stem: In excess chlorine gas, iron reacts to form iron(III) chloride. Calculate the mass of FeCl3(s) produced when 11.2 g of iron is used.

Phosphoric acid reacts with calcium hydroxide to produce calcium phosphate and water. If 6.50 g of H3PO4(aq) reacts completely with excess Ca(OH)2(aq), what mass of Ca3(PO4)2(s) is produced? Write a balanced chemical equation for the reaction.

Use the lab data below to determine the percentage yield of silver chloride, AgCl(s), produced when excess sodium chloride is added to silver nitrate solution. Lab data: mass of AgNO3 used = 1.62 g; mass of clean, dry filter paper = 1.14 g; mass of dry precipitate and filter paper = 2.48 g. Write the balanced chemical equation for the reaction.
question_records.answer_hint: AgNO3 + NaCl -> AgCl + NaNO3; actual precipitate mass = 1.34 g; theoretical yield is about 1.37 g AgCl; percentage yield is about 98.0%
